description: CVVDP (ColorVideoVDP) and SSIMULACRA2 on the 99 size-range photos (bench/openimages_v4_gamut.csv), re-encoded exactly as published on an AWS g6.4xlarge (NVIDIA L4)

cvvdp.display_name: 24-inch FullHD monitor, peak luminance 200 cd/m^2, viewed under office light levels (250 lux), seen from 2 x display height
cvvdp.inputs: 8-bit sRGB (ICC profiles converted with LittleCMS, relative colorimetric), 1:1 pixel mapping

cvvdp_luma_only.note: diagnostic: both images converted to grey (Pillow L) after the sRGB conversion, so CVVDP sees luminance only
